question: Nishagandhi Award is related to which state government?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Kerala**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Classical dancer **mrinalini sarabhai** was awarded the **maiden nishagandhi puraskaram** of Kerala Tourism.
 
• The award was** presented by** the chief minister of Kerala **Mr Oommen chandy.** in Thiruvananthapuram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The nishagandi award was presented **on the occasion of the concluding day of the nishagandhi dance and music festival**.
 
• The annual award comprising a purse of Rs.1.5 lakh, citation and statuette.
 
• Award is given to honour eminent personalities in the fields of dance and music.
 
• Mallika sarabhai received the award on behalf of her mother.
 
• She is the daughter of mrinalini sarabhai who was nominated for the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other important Awards in kerala
 
 
• **Vallathol Award**-

 
 
• Award instituted** by Vallathol Sahitya Samithi** with a prize money of Rs. 1,11,111 and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Vayalar Award-**
 
 
• **​**A is given for best literary work in Malayalam instituted by Vayalar Ramavarma Memorial Trust from 1977
 
• The award includes a prize money of Rs. 25,000/- and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Odakkuzhal Award-**
 
 
• **​**Award instituted in 1969 by renowned poet G. Sankara Kurup to commemorate the Jnanpith Award.
 
• The award is given to literary works in Malayalam and the prize money is Rs. 10,000.
 
 
 
• **Edasseri Award-**
 
 
• **​**An award instituted by Ponnani Edasseri Smaraka Samithi.
 
 
 
 

5e:T
